column1: # Used by VisionCalibrationEngine to define where to collect vision calibration data
#   name: Unique identifier for this calibration point (e.g.
#   x_meters: Field X coordinate in meters (0-8.2 typical)
#   y_meters: Field Y coordinate in meters (0-4.1 typical)
#   rotation_degrees: Robot heading in degrees (0=facing red side
#   initial_position: true if this is the calibration starting/reset position
#   - Exactly ONE point must have initial_position=true (your reference position)
#   - All other points (initial_position=false) are relative to this reference
#   - Robot will reset odometry to this position before starting calibration
#   Blue Alliance: X increases toward red (0-8.2m)
#   - Multi-point calibration uses proportional drive (0.5 m/s max)
#   - Robot bounded to 1.5m radius from initial position during spiral
